title: Izwi Rinobva Mugwenzi Rinopfuta
intro: Fungidzira hunhu hwemunhu akadzama ane rwendo rwakatanga nekusangana kunoshamisa uye mugumo wake wakabatana nekusunungurwa kwevanhu vakadzvinyirirwa. Munhu uyu akasarudzwa kuti aite basa guru, achitarisana nematambudziko makuru nerutsigiro rwaMwari.
clues: Ndakazvarirwa munguva yekudzvinyirirwa kukuru, uko vacheche vevanhu vangu vaiurayiwa.
Hupenyu hwangu hwepakutanga hwaisanganisira kuiswa murwizi nemubereki wangu, asi ndakawanikwa ndikakurira mumhuri yemudzvinyiriri wevanhu vangu.
Ndakambotiza muguta mushure mekunge ndauraya mumwe munhu ndisingazive panguva yekukakavadzana.
Ndakagamuchira shoko raMwari netsvimbo inoshamisa panzvimbo tsvene, kwandakarayirwa kuti ndinosangana nemutongi ane simba.
Mukoma wangu akagadzwa semubatsiri kwandiri mubasa rangu, nekuda kwekunetseka kwandaiita pakutaura.
Ndakatungamira vanhu vangu kuyambuka gungwa rakaparadzana, ndichitiza kudzingirirwa neuto rine hutsinye.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
